method: read-only source sweep of flow-companion/extension/src + manifest + tests (Explore agent, very thorough)

findings.title: MV3: approval gate state (approvals Map) in-memory only, dies with service worker
findings.impact: worker reaped between APPROVE_RECORD and SUBMIT_GENERATE → false APPROVAL_REQUIRED failure on credit path (fail-safe: blocks, never duplicates)
findings.recommendedAction: persist approval {jobId,attempt,nonce,fingerprint,approvedAt} to chrome.storage.session; lazy rehydrate in consumeLocalApproval

findings.title: sidepanel bridgeCall has no timeout (approve/generate/import can wait forever)
findings.evidence: src/ui/sidepanel.js:112-132 plain fetch, no AbortController; bridge-client.js:32-63 has 15s timeout but is never loaded
findings.impact: hung loopback server → dead silent wait on credit path (Q17 violation surface)

findings.title: render() rewrites jobCard.innerHTML every cycle, destroying keyboard focus during polling
findings.evidence: src/ui/sidepanel.js:229,249,252; called from AWAIT_SUBMIT_ACCEPTANCE loop :680-683 and guard() :100
findings.impact: focus dropped to body every ~5s for up to 10 min (a11y); DOM churn
findings.recommendedAction: skip re-render when rendered signature unchanged; never re-render while focus inside card

findings.title: GENERATING poll gives no user-visible feedback when Flow tab disappears (spins 10 min)
findings.evidence: src/ui/sidepanel.js:768-772 log-only + continue; deadline :759; same in acceptance loop :672-674
findings.impact: normal user sees busy CTA 10 min with no message despite diagnosable FLOW_TAB_NOT_FOUND
findings.recommendedAction: after N consecutive unreachable polls, surface friendly error + NEED_FLOW

findings.title: status chip accessible name static; no aria-live for state changes
findings.recommendedAction: drop static aria-label; aria-live=polite on status text

findings.title: BLOCKED CTA silently enables Developer Mode (persisted)
findings.impact: normal user switched to dev persona without notice
findings.recommendedAction: show human error card only; explicit opt-in for dev mode

findings.title: small unbounded buffers: #log pre grows unbounded; AWAIT_BASELINES/acceptancePolls Maps never pruned
findings.evidence: sidepanel.js:68-71; content-commands.js:72-73,983,1007-1011; observer hot paths bounded by timeoutMs
findings.recommendedAction: cap log ~200 lines; prune Maps on acceptance

findings.title: token auto-recovery fires mid-typing (500ms debounce per keystroke)
raw error code shown in toast on approval/generation failure
findings.evidence: sidepanel.js:753; import toast :860 loses lastError reason
findings.recommendedAction: show body in toast, codes stay in details card

findings.title: credit-gate helpers exported but untested (consumeLocalApproval nonce/fingerprint semantics)
findings.impact: most credit-sensitive extension logic untested (Q15/Q16 evidence gap)
findings.recommendedAction: add TI test group: replay, attempt mismatch, nonce mismatch, fingerprint mismatch, both-absent compat

findings.title: FETCH_RESULT_BYTES credentialed fetch of message-supplied URL without origin constraint
findings.evidence: content-commands.js:1041-1057 credentials:include, only non-empty check; validateSender allows extension pages + Flow content scripts
findings.impact: defense-in-depth: content-script compromise could exfiltrate via credentialed fetch
findings.recommendedAction: constrain msg.url to captured result-candidate origins / google-owned https hosts

clean: normal-mode information hygiene (dev-mode gated; 5 user questions answered)
no indefinite keepalive (no alarms/held ports; bounded polls)
post-wake duplicate-submit protection (fail-safe direction; single-use approval bound jobId+attempt+nonce+fingerprint)
canonical tab resolver vs MV3 restarts (re-resolve + re-ping; storage.session non-secret)
token handling (persist only after auth success; never echoed; forget control; TRUSTED_CONTEXTS; loopback-locked; SW never holds token; no token logging)
debugger permission gating (op allowlist, origin+projectRef match, detach)
result correlation (no candidate adoption without persisted candidates; baseline diff; 60MB cap)
keyboard operability otherwise (native controls, focus-visible, no traps)
